Removes specified HTML elements by CSS selector before processing

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"remove_tags\":[\"nav\",\"aside\",\"footer\"],\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.html())
```
